questions.question: How many members currently serve in the Knesset, and how many of them are women?
questions.gold: 120 current MKs, of whom 33 are women.
questions.notes: KNS_PersonToPosition PositionID in (43,61) AND IsCurrent=1, gender from KNS_Person. Both numbers needed for full credit.

questions.question: How many different women served as Knesset members at any point during the 25th Knesset?
questions.notes: Distinct PersonID with PositionID in (43,61), KnessetNum=25, GenderDesc female.

questions.question: Who is the current Speaker of the Knesset, and on what date did they take office?
questions.notes: PositionID 122/123 (Speaker). Name alone = partial credit.

questions.question: Who is the only woman ever to have served as Speaker of the Knesset, and during which Knesset did she serve?
questions.notes: PositionID 123.

questions.question: In the 25th Knesset, how many bills were submitted in total, and how many of them passed their third reading (became law)?
questions.notes: KNS_Bill KnessetNum=25; passed = StatusID 118 ('התקבלה בקריאה שלישית'). Includes all SubTypes.

questions.question: Of the bills that passed their third reading in the 25th Knesset, how many were government bills, how many were private members' bills, and how many were committee bills?
questions.notes: KNS_Bill.SubTypeDesc ממשלתית/פרטית/ועדה with StatusID 118.

questions.question: How many no-confidence motions were brought to a plenum vote during the 25th Knesset?
questions.notes: KNS_PlenumVote.ForOptionDesc = 'להביע אי-אמון בממשלה', session in Knesset 25 (or VoteDateTime >= 2022-11-15). NOTE: IsNoConfidenceInGov is almost always NULL (only 4 rows set) -- answering 4 or ~0 is wrong.

questions.question: How many parliamentary questions (queries to ministers) were filed in the 25th Knesset, and what share of them have been answered?
questions.notes: KNS_Query KnessetNum=25; answered = StatusID 9 ('נענתה'). Regular: 1,378 (899 answered); urgent: 202 (201 answered).

questions.question: Which government ministry received the most parliamentary questions in the 25th Knesset?
questions.notes: KNS_Query.GovMinistryID -> KNS_GovMinistry. Runner-up: Defense (162).

questions.question: Which Knesset member filed the most parliamentary questions in the 25th Knesset?
questions.notes: KNS_Query.PersonID. Runner-up Michael Biton (88).

questions.question: Which Knesset member(s) served in the largest number of different Knessets, and how many?
questions.gold: A three-way tie at 14 Knessets: Benjamin Netanyahu, Moshe Gafni and Shimon Peres.
questions.notes: Distinct KnessetNum per person with PositionID in (43,61). Naming only one of the three with 14 = partial credit.

questions.question: How many of Israel's Basic Laws are currently in force?
questions.gold: 14 (19 laws are flagged as Basic Laws in total, including repealed versions and expired temporary budget Basic Laws).
questions.notes: KNS_IsraelLaw IsBasicLaw=1 AND LawValidityDesc='תקף'. Answering 19 without filtering validity = wrong.

questions.question: How many different people have held the office of Prime Minister of Israel (the position itself, including interim PMs, but not titles like vice/acting PM or alternate PM)?
questions.gold: 15 (including interim PM Yigal Allon); 14 excluding him.
questions.notes: PositionID 45 only. Accept 15, or 14 if the answer explicitly excludes Allon as interim. v2 wording: v1 said 'including acting PMs', which ambiguously invited PositionID 51 (vice/acting PM title, e.g. Tzipi Livni).

questions.question: What was the plenum vote tally on the final (third) reading of the 'reasonableness' amendment -- Basic Law: The Judiciary (Amendment No. 4) -- in July 2023?
questions.gold: 64 in favor, 0 against (the opposition boycotted the vote).
questions.notes: KNS_PlenumVote Id 39785 (2023-07-24, 'לקבל את הצעת החוק בקריאה שלישית'). The second-reading vote was 64-56 -- giving that = wrong.

questions.question: Which Knesset member was listed as an initiator (not a later co-signer) on the most bills in the 25th Knesset?
questions.notes: KNS_BillInitiator IsInitiator=1, bills with KnessetNum=25. Runner-up Sharon Nir 398. Also top if counting first-listed initiator only (Ordinal=1, 278).

questions.question: Which Knesset member was an initiator of the most bills that passed into law (third reading) in the 25th Knesset?
questions.notes: KNS_BillInitiator joined to KNS_Bill StatusID=118, KnessetNum=25. Runner-up Yinon Azoulay 35.

questions.question: How many factions (parliamentary groups) have been registered in the 25th Knesset?
questions.notes: KNS_Faction KnessetNum=25 (includes splits such as Idan Roll's single-MK faction).

questions.question: How many sessions did the Knesset Finance Committee hold during the 25th Knesset (excluding cancelled sessions)?
questions.notes: KNS_Committee Id 4186 'ועדת הכספים'; KNS_CommitteeSession StatusDesc != 'מבוטלת'. Answering 1,146 = partial credit.

questions.question: How many different people served as government ministers in Israel's 37th government?
questions.notes: KNS_PersonToPosition PositionID in (39,57) (minister m/f) with GovernmentNum=37; including PM does not change the count.

questions.question: How often did Itamar Ben Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich vote the same way in plenum votes?
questions.notes: mk_vote_agreement(30811, 30055): agreement_rate 0.99893, shared_votes 1873. Rate within +/-0.5pp is correct.

questions.question: In how many plenum votes did Benjamin Netanyahu cast a recorded vote during 2025, out of how many plenum votes held that year?
questions.notes: KNS_PlenumVoteResult MkId=965 with VoteDate in 2025; KNS_PlenumVote VoteDateTime in 2025.

questions.question: How many different Knesset members belonged to the Likud faction at some point during the 25th Knesset?
questions.notes: Distinct PersonID with PositionID 54, KnessetNum=25, FactionName starting 'הליכוד'.
